content: {"paper_id":"W3092285484","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","exact_quote":"This paper proposes to associate a multivariate label distribution (MLD) to each image.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文为每张图像关联多变量标记分布，并提出算法从MLD学习，符合标记分布学习任务。"},{"keyword_id":"label-enhancement","exact_quote":"it is better to use soft labels rather than explicit hard labels to indicate the pose of a face image","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文用软标记/MLD替代原始硬姿态标签，构建更细致的标记分布，符合标记增强。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"the MLD-based methods appear much more robust against the label noise in the training set","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确讨论训练集中的标签噪声并检验方法鲁棒性，符合噪声标签学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"an extension of MLD with the hierarchical structure is proposed to deal with fine-grained head pose estimation","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过分层结构扩展MLD以处理细粒度头部姿态，显式利用标签层级依赖关系，属于标签相关性建模。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
